The corners of the binder are not perfectly sharp, showing slight warping (Router severity 1.5). These defects prevent a perfect artifact score, as rigid office supplies should have crisp geometry. The high mask confidence from the Topology Auditor confirms no major fragmentation, but the visual warping remains a valid defect.
